text:
Hanging from her buttocks, she repeatedly wore the garland of saffron threads, as if she were the second Mouri, the companion of the archer, placed in its proper position by one who knows the rites.

Her breath, fragrant and increasing her thirst, approached the fruit-like lips of the two-eyed one; moment by moment, her gaze, trembling with confusion, was calmed by the playful lotus.

Seeing her, flawless in all her limbs, even in the act of love she assumed an air of modesty; the archer, master of his senses, with his flower-bow, again hoped for the success of his endeavor.
